title: River's End: The Beginning
summary: Five journeys converged on one point in history. In a rickety wagon the five of them sat, each on the way to their own adventure — unaware of the road ahead, and unaware that peril was driving the carriage.

title: Ambush in the Shady Glen
summary: An explosion rocked the wagon and bandits leapt from the woods, led by an extremely annoying wizard who blinked from space to space. The party was at its most divided here — some surrendered to the guards, others ran for the river.

title: The Castle of Clones
summary: A group of individuals who looked just like the party were causing trouble near River's End. The party laid wait at the castle, caught them up, and found a werewolf among them. One clone escaped — nobody can remember which. In the tower they found ledgers indicting Tom Thistlethumb.

title: The Road to Valen
summary: With names still to clear and at least one more twin to kill, the party followed the trail toward Valen. Here Forsyth left them, reaching out a hand to one of the village widows.
